audit_metadata.title: Phase 9.1.2 Spatial Coverage and Data Integration Audit

spatial_ambiguity_assessment.scientific_interpretation: A 42.4 m distance is strictly smaller than the 150 m coordinate precision uncertainty. Under geometric buffering by reported precision (150 m), the source coordinate overlaps glacier outline RGI60-15.04173. The raw point-in-polygon False result does not prove the detachment initiated in ice-free rock.

rgi_provenance.limitation: RGI 6.0 historical outlines do not reflect instantaneous 2026 terminus positions or high-altitude hanging glacier retreat.

elevation_provenance.reconciliation: Detachment headwall initiated at ~6,200 m (NW face cliff), while lower breaklines and deposition throat into Lhende gorge occurred at ~5,100 m.

location_clarification.candidate_source_region: Shringri Himal cirque, upstream of Udilung Khola
location_clarification.blockage_reach: Confluence of Udilung and Syar Khola

langtang_hydrology.headwaters: Upper Lhende Khola cirque below Langtang Lirung NW face
langtang_hydrology.tributary_junction: Lhende Khola joins Bhote Koshi at Rasuwagadhi (Nepal-China border)
langtang_hydrology.downstream_axis: Bhote Koshi -> Trishuli River -> Betrawati -> Devghat (Narayani confluence)
langtang_hydrology.relationship_to_monitored_lakes: None of the 5 monitored lakes (Imja, Tsho Rolpa, Thulagi, Lower Barun, Sabai) are hydrologically connected to Lhende Khola or Bhote Koshi. Closest monitored lake is Tsho Rolpa (104.9 km east in Tama Koshi) and Thulagi (104.2 km west in Marshyangdi).

budhi_gandaki_hydrology.headwaters: Tibetan border transboundary catchments flowing south into Shiar Khola and Upper Budhi Gandaki
budhi_gandaki_hydrology.tributary_junction: Shiar Khola confluence near Chumchet / Chhekampar
budhi_gandaki_hydrology.downstream_axis: Budhi Gandaki mainstem -> Philim -> Jagat -> Arughat -> Benighat (Trishuli confluence)
budhi_gandaki_hydrology.relationship_to_monitored_lakes: Thulagi Lake is 47.6 km west in the Marshyangdi basin, separated by the massive Manaslu-Larkya mountain divide. Zero hydrological drainage overlap.

representation_in_ml_training_features.scientific_rationale: GlacierGuard-AI's feature pipeline is trained exclusively on GLO lake polygons (2017-2024). Steep mountain rock-ice faces, hanging glaciers, and river corridor landslide blockages are entirely absent from the training matrix. Basin-level Gandaki or Koshi metadata cannot be conflated with local spatial representation.
